instruction: Add local folders named NEWSLETTER and PROMOTIONS to Thunderbird.

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating two local folders in Thunderbird (NEWSLETTER and PROMOTIONS). Evaluator checks for both folder files and .msf metadata files. Same complexity as original task with different folder names.
metadata.verification: Verified evaluator checks for NEWSLETTER and PROMOTIONS folders and their .msf files using regex patterns.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses postconfig to recursively list Thunderbird Local Folders directory with 'ls -R', ensuring fresh state capture
Getter logic correctly reads the cached file output using get_cache_file
Metric check_list correctly compiles regex patterns and searches line-by-line for all expected patterns
Complete coverage: Evaluator verifies both NEWSLETTER and PROMOTIONS folders plus their associated .msf metadata files (4 patterns total)
Expected regex patterns are semantically correct: \bNEWSLETTER\.msf\b and \bNEWSLETTER/?(?!\.msf) properly match folder and metadata file separately
Same logic applies correctly for PROMOTIONS folder
The negative lookahead (?!\.msf) in folder patterns ensures the folder itself is matched, not just the .msf file
Evaluator will return 1.0 only if all 4 patterns are found, 0.0 otherwise - correct verification logic
State accessibility is guaranteed: postconfig executes after task completion, ls -R captures current directory state
No edge case issues: check_list handles file reading errors, returns 0.0 if file is None
